title: Proximate Objectives
coreMove: Translate uncertainty into a near-enough objective people can act on now.
sourcePressure: Proximate objectives give concentrated force a credible next target under uncertainty: close enough to coordinate action without pretending the whole path is known. Frozen source has no chapter-specific named figure, study, place, or event beyond the visible title/support notes; use conceptual source terms only and do not invent anchors.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: A proximate objective is just a quarterly goal or easier milestone.
